title: Lean formalization
headline: Three laws of biology machine-checked in Lean 4 (Kimura k = mu via the proved fixation probability, Fisher FTNS, Maynard Smith twofold cost) plus one extension proved for the hub's flying-fish question: fixation is at least i/M whenever selection does not oppose the mutant, instantiated on Wright-Fisher with s >= 0. 24 theorems, 50 lemmas, 0 sorry, standard axioms only; 9 of 9 statement mutants rejected, 4/4 controls. Flying-fish budget (Darwin ch. VI): over the 48.07-56 Ma since the oldest Exocoetidae fossil (PBDB), the neutral budget is 0.053-0.451 substitutions per site, independent of N by the theorem; the adaptive floor depends on an undefined favored-mutation rate and the ceiling 2 N mu T is vacuous; the substitutions a wing requires are undefined, so the verdict is inconclusive. Every parameter names its source; no Exocoetidae measurement of mu, generation time or N exists. 16 unsigned nanopub drafts (5 law, 5 scope, 1 bound linked to the organism thread's blueprint record, 1 rubric, 4 assessment) pass np check + parse + Delphi lint; no human named; nothing signed, committed or published.
